newsitem.title: SPAIN: Cow dies after downing spirits at Spanish fiesta.
newsitem.headline: Cow dies after downing spirits at Spanish fiesta.

text.p: Spanish officials were investigating on Friday the case of a cow which died after being forced to drink litres of alcohol during a religious festival in northern Spain, local police said.
Police said the cow probably died of a heart attack after youths poured alcohol down its throat before a crowd of revellers last weekend in the remote village of Villardefrades.
"We have identified the culprits but cannot arrest them due to a lack of law to back us up...now we have to wait until the judge studies our findings," an officer told Reuters.
Local media reported that the cow had consumed up to five litres (just over a gallon) of whisky, but police would not confirm this.
The case shocked animal rights activists who are continually fighting to stamp out animal abuse commonly committed during Spain's festival season.

"This is just horrifying...animals are sometimes forced to drink alcohol at these festivals, but this is the first time one has died," said Eva Vallejo, spokeswoman for the National Association for the Defence of Animals.
Police said they would deliver the findings of the investigation on Saturday or Monday.
